IOP Coalitions

The IOP's Coalitions provide student-led opportunities for members to engage with a topic or affinity marker of their choice, and to elevate programming features that may be otherwise represented in the IOP's calendar and/or existing programs.

Our Undergraduate Coalitions


Coalition for the Arts 

The Coalition for the Arts is dedicated to exploring the intersection between arts and politics. By bringing artists and changemakers to the IOP, the coalition introduces students to a broad spectrum of artistic mediums, and explores how such artistry intersects with political thought, governance, and policy.

Conservative Coalition 

The Conservative Coalition is a hub for all Harvard College students interested in developing their political identity through community, conversation, and events while working together to advocate for IOP-wide conservative representation, broad ideological inclusion, and public service opportunities for students of all ideological backgrounds.

Gender & Sexuality Coalition (GSC) 

The GSC is dedicated to fostering insightful conversations and profound explorations of the multifaceted realms of gender and sexuality within the realm of politics and beyond. Through an array of engaging activities, the Gender and Sexuality Coalition seeks to invigorate dialogue, elevate understanding, and champion inclusivity.

Service Coalition 

The Service Coalition at the Institute of Politics honors patriotism and recognizes the significance of both domestic and foreign federal service. It serves as a platform for individuals with backgrounds or interests in federal service, the Peace Corps, or the military to engage in candid discussions on policy matters typically not addressed in conventional military or agency settings.
